commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; git rev-parse HEAD; rg --files --hidden -g '"'!.git'"'; cat delivery.md README.md docs/export-notes.md; git diff; git diff --cached"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tasklist/__init__.py tests/test_tasks.py; git log -5 --oneline; rg -n --hidden -g '"'!.git'"' 'complet|confirm|repeat|done|message' ."

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('README.md'), Path('delivery.md'), Path('docs/task-completion.md'), Path('docs/work/investigation/repeated-completion.md')]
count = 0
for path in paths:
    for target in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', path.read_text()):
        assert (path.parent / target).is_file(), (path, target)
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local Markdown links across {len(paths)} documents; all resolve.')
PY"
